details: Coinbase Financial Markets has become the first US-regulated Futures Commission Merchant (FCM) to receive approval from the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) to offer US clients access to global crypto perpetual futures and options. This landmark decision opens up a multi-trillion-dollar derivatives market, previously largely inaccessible to US traders, with institutional onboarding commencing immediately and retail access planned for a later stage.
title: Coinbase Approved by CFTC for Global Crypto Derivatives Access

details: US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have experienced substantial outflows, totaling $2.8 billion over the past nine days and $229 million on May 28th alone, marking the longest outflow streak since their inception. BlackRock's IBIT ETF notably recorded its largest single-day net outflow. This trend signals heightened risk-off sentiment among institutional investors, driven by prevailing macroeconomic uncertainty and geopolitical tensions.
title: Bitcoin ETFs Face Record $2.8B Outflow as Macro Concerns Mount

details: Ethereum (ETH) continues to demonstrate weakness, trading below the $2,000 psychological level, exacerbated by 13 consecutive days of net outflows from US spot ETH ETFs, amounting to approximately $695 million. Despite some whale accumulation, derivatives data indicates elevated leverage and positive funding rates, suggesting crowded long positions that could lead to further downside if the critical $1,800-$1,750 support zone fails.
title: Ethereum Price Nears $1,800 as ETF Outflows & Leverage Weigh

details: CME Group, the world's largest derivatives exchange, has implemented nearly 24/7 trading for its suite of Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other altcoin futures and options products. This strategic move eliminates previous weekend trading gaps, providing institutional traders with uninterrupted access to the market, enhancing liquidity, and improving price discovery for digital asset derivatives, pending regulatory review.
title: CME Group Launches Continuous 24/7 Trading for Crypto Futures

details: Solana (SOL) price is currently holding above the crucial $80 support zone, trading around $82, despite broader market corrections and macroeconomic uncertainty. Concurrently, the Solana Company (HSDT) has increased its at-the-market equity offering to $250 million, with plans to utilize the proceeds to accumulate SOL tokens. On-chain data also highlights strong demand for Solana's network, with its decentralized exchanges processing a monthly volume of $36.9 billion, surpassing Ethereum's.
title: Solana Defends $80 Support; Company Expands Equity Offering for SOL Accumulation
